hook: Women's monthly bus pass now priced at *15 days*
hook_b: Women's monthly bus pass now priced at *15 days*
tldr: TGSRTC's revised Monthly Season Ticket scheme with nine concessions takes effect across Telangana from Saturday, November 14.

beats.what: Women pay a 15-day fare (was 20) including tolls; for others, tolls are counted for 20 days instead of 25, and the distance limit on passes is gone.
beats.why: TGSRTC says the move aims to boost ridership and make daily bus travel cheaper for students, employees and regular commuters.
beats.care: Sunday free rides apply in Hyderabad, Warangal, Nizamabad, Nalgonda and Karimnagar city buses, but not on government holidays or Pushpak Airport Liners.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: A new combi-ticket lets pass holders board a higher-category bus for an extra Rs 20 per journey; two- and three-month passes get 5 and 10 bonus days.
